recentItems.title: Jennifer Aniston, Boyfriend Jim Curtis Discuss His Past Paralysis | E! News
recentItems.description:
Jim Curtis isn’t afraid to share his struggles with Jennifer Aniston. In fact, the hypnotist shared insight into his health journey during an onstage conversation with the Friends star at the 92nd Street Y in New York City Sept. 2 to celebrate the release of his new book, 'The Book of Possibility.' During their talk, Curtis shared with Aniston how difficult it was for him when doctors found lesions on his spinal cord in his 20s that led to partial paralysis and chronic nerve damage. “I’m not saying here that if the doctor tells you to do something, you should get up and leave,” Curtis told Aniston and the audience, according to Us Weekly. “What I’m saying is you don’t have to live as the victim. You don’t have to live in your suffering. It can become your power.” While he noted the key to moving beyond a health challenge is to “accept it and love it,” acceptance was difficult for the 50-year-old, who admitted that he wasn’t always open with those who asked him why he walks with a limp. “I would say I got into a motorcycle accident,” Curtis said. “I was so shameful that I had a medical condition. [I thought] I was broken in some way. I thought the motorcycle accident was at least a little macho.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435697/jennifer-anistons-boyfriend-jim-curtis-shares-health-issue-past-paralysis

recentItems.title: Disney Channel Actress Carla Jeffery Dead at 33 | E! News
recentItems.description:
The Zombies franchise is mourning one of its stars. Carla Jeffrey, who played cheerleader Bree in the hit Disney Channel film series, has died at the age of 33. The actress’s longtime manager confirmed her Sept. 1 passing in an Instagram post the next day, calling Jeffery “a beautiful, vibrant and incredibly talented woman whose radiant smile could light up any room.” Several of Jeffery’s Zombies costars, such as Chandler Kinney and Milo Manheim, paid their tributes in the Instagram comments. In addition to ‘Zombies,’ Jeffery made appearances in shows like Southland, Curb Your Enthusiasm, Shake It Up and Good Luck Charlie. An official cause of death has not been revealed.

recentItems.title: Travis Kelce Bought Lakefront Ohio Home Before Taylor Swift Wedding | E! News
recentItems.description:
Travis Kelce is tackling a new venture. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end bought a newly-renovated mansion in Ohio just four months before tying the knot with Taylor Swift in July, according to multiple outlets. In March, Travis closed on the lakefront property in Bratenahl—not far from the city of Cleveland Heights where he and brother Jason Kelce grew up—for $5.35 million, according to The Wall Street Journal, who obtained property records and spoke to people familiar with the deal. The property sits on 3.5 acres along the edge of Lake Erie, according to the property records. And in addition to being located near a private airport, the listing viewed by WSJ revealed the 21,000 square foot home has eight bedrooms, 11 bathrooms, a game room and home theater. Following Travis’ purchase, David Ayers and Nick Zawitz of The Agency Cleveland, who brokered the sale, told WSJ in a Sept. 1 statement, “We’re thrilled for the new owners and so excited for Cleveland.” Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435685/travis-kelce-bought-s5-35-million-ohio-home-before-taylor-swift-wedding

recentItems.title: Cher Slams Son Elijah's Wife Over "Quest for Money" in Conservatorship | E! News
recentItems.description:
Cher is taking legal action against her daughter-in-law. Amid the “Believe” singer’s continued fight to appoint a guardian for son Elijah Blue Allman, 50, the 80-year-old filed a supplemental brief in Los Angeles court August. 28, alleging that his wife Marieangela King-Allman, 39, is only seeking to be Elijah’s conservator for monetary gain and should not be “considered as a viable candidate to serve as a court-appointed fiduciary” – citing the couple’s past attempts to divorce as well as King-Allman’s supposed estrangement from her husband as supporting evidence. In a statement to E! News, King-Allman fired back, claiming that Cher “abandoned” her son during his youth and that the Moonstruck actress is also estranged from him. recentItems.title: Lawyer for Wheel of Fortune’s Jim Thornton Speaks Out After Suspension | E! News
recentItems.description:
Jim Thornton is attempting to clear his name. After 'Wheel of Fortune' announced that its longtime announcer was suspended from the ABC game show following undisclosed allegations, his lawyer spoke out to defend him. Thornton’s attorney told TMZ in a Sept. 1 statement that the announcer "did not engage in any illegal conduct, was not arrested, and has not been charged with any crime.” Plus, the lawyer provided details on the alleged incident, which involved Thornton and a fellow passenger on an American Airlines flight in May. “When questioned about the complaint made by a fellow passenger on the flight,” the attorney continued, “law enforcement spoke to him for five minutes or less, immediately determined that no wrongdoing had occurred and told my client he was free to go." For their part, American Airlines previously confirmed that law enforcement was called to the scene after the alleged incident occurred, sharing in a Sept. 1 statement, "On May 14, American Airlines Flight 1276 was met by law enforcement upon arrival at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) following concerns reported by a customer onboard." While Sony Pictures Television—which produces the game show—didn’t provide details about the allegations against Thornton, the company told E! News in a Sept. 1 statement that he “has been suspended from 'Wheel of Fortune' and we are recasting while we conduct a thorough investigation.” Full Story:

recentItems.title: Taylor Hanson Reveals How Boy Band Past Is Helping With DWTS | E! News
recentItems.description:
Luckily, Taylor Hanson’s moves weren’t actually gone in an MMMBop. In fact, as the Hanson member prepares to compete on season 35 of 'Dancing With the Stars,' he and pro partner Britt Stewart, the two have found that his experience as a musician is certainly giving him a leg up. “It's very, very helpful,” Stewart told E! News in an exclusive joint interview with Hanson following the DWTS cast reveal on Sept. 2. “I love that each season I get to really teach and choreograph and curate this journey for whoever my partner is.” The 36-year-old added, “There was a moment in rehearsal the other day where I'm like, he's teaching me about music within my knowledge of music that I have already. And Taylor said it so many times: music and dance—they're so connected. So it’s definitely a strength that I'm using this season.” Hanson added with a laugh, “It’s a strength I have to bring to the table.” And the 43-year-old—who shares kids Ezra, 23, Penelope, 21, River, 19, Viggo, 17, Wilhelmina, 13, Indiana, 7, and Maybellene, 5, with wife Natalie—knows his time on the ABC series will be en pointe. “It's a blast,” he raved. “What people feel from the show is real. There's a real familial energy. People are supportive of each other.” And he knows the importance of that familial energy given he’s spent more than 30 years in a band with brothers Isaac Hanson and Zac Hanson. “Obviously, it's a competition show,” the “This Time Around” singer added, “so we're going to see the eye of the tiger with everybody. But it's exciting.” Season 35 of 'Dancing with the Stars' premieres with a special two-night event on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, and Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET on ABC and Disney+.
